info.title: SearchAtlas API
info.description:
# SearchAtlas API Documentation

Each service has its own base URL. All endpoints require `X-API-Key` header.

Get your key at [Dashboard - API Settings](https://dashboard.searchatlas.com/settings?active_section=api).

get.description:
Returns playbooks suitable for the "Quick Run" panel - typically public/VIP playbooks
that can be started immediately without configuration.

Returns a paginated list of playbooks. Supports filtering by agent namespace,
ownership type, tags, and free-text search.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Free-text search across name and description

post.description:
Creates a new private playbook. Rate-limited per user.
Supports bi-directional tag/namespace sync:
if `tag_ids` is provided, `agent_namespaces` is derived from tags;
if `agent_namespaces` is provided, tags are derived from namespaces.

example.name: Weekly SEO Review
example.description: Analyzes top-performing pages and suggests improvements
example.instruction: Review the site's top 10 pages by organic traffic. For each page, check keyword alignment, title/meta quality, and Core Web Vitals. Summarize top 3 improvements per page.

400.description: Validation error (name too short, duplicate name, invalid references)

get.description: Returns full playbook including instruction content, mission template, and credit range.

put.description: Replaces all mutable playbook fields. Only the owner can update.

patch.description:
Partially updates a playbook. Pass `?is_active=false` to archive the playbook
(soft-delete that can be recovered via `recover-all-archives`).

delete.description:
Soft-deletes (archives) the playbook. Pass `?hard=true` for permanent deletion.
Archived playbooks can be recovered with `POST /api/playbooks/recover-all-archives/`.

post.description:
Creates a private copy of a public or shared playbook for the authenticated user.
Rate-limited. Optionally provide a custom name for the clone.

name.description: Optional custom name for the cloned playbook

post.description: Bulk unarchives all soft-deleted (archived) playbooks for the authenticated user.
Bulk permanently deletes all archived playbooks for the authenticated user. Irreversible.

get.description: Returns all active icons that can be assigned to playbooks. Response is cached.
Returns all agent projects for the authenticated account.

post.description:
Creates a new agent project for a domain. Optionally triggers project setup
in the LinkGraph system via `setup_project=true`.

Sends a message to the Atlas Brain multi-agent coordinator.
Returns `202 Accepted` immediately. The response streams over the WebSocket
connection for the session identified in the request body.

202.description: Message accepted - response delivered via WebSocket

post.summary: Send message to OTTO SEO brain
post.description:
Sends a message to the OTTO SEO optimization agent.
Returns `202 Accepted`; response streams over WebSocket.

get.description: Returns the current processing status for an OTTO agent session.

post.summary: Send message to Ad Brain (OTTO PPC)
post.description:
Sends a message to the OTTO PPC (Smartads) agent for Google Ads optimization.
Returns `202 Accepted`; response streams over WebSocket.

Sends a message to the Content Genius agent. Supports brand vault and article context
for content creation workflows. Returns `202 Accepted`; response streams over WebSocket.

post.summary: Send message to Website Studio agent
post.description:
Sends a message to the Landing Page / Website Studio agent.
Returns `202 Accepted`; response streams over WebSocket.

post.summary: Send message to GBP / Local SEO brain
post.description:
Sends a message to the Local SEO (Google Business Profile) agent.
Returns `202 Accepted`; response streams over WebSocket.

post.summary: Send message to GBP heatmaps specialist
post.description: Sends a message to the GBP heatmaps specialist agent. Returns `202 Accepted`.

post.summary: Send message to GBP citations specialist
post.description: Sends a message to the GBP citations specialist agent. Returns `202 Accepted`.

post.summary: Send message to Authority Building brain
post.description: Sends a message to the Authority Building agent. Returns `202 Accepted`.

post.summary: Send message to Site Explorer brain
post.description: Sends a message to the Site Explorer agent. Returns `202 Accepted`.

post.summary: Send message to LLM Visibility brain
post.description: Sends a message to the LLM Visibility agent. Returns `202 Accepted`.
Sends a message to the Keywords research agent. Returns `202 Accepted`.

get.description:
Returns a paginated list of conversation sessions for the authenticated user.
Filter by agent namespace, or search by session title.

Returns all messages in a conversation session, ordered by timestamp.
Internal fields (`tool_calls`, `tool_results`) are stripped from assistant message content.

patch.description:
Updates a session's title or active status.
Pass `is_active: false` to soft-delete (archive) the session.

post.description:
Soft-deletes the specified assistant message and re-triggers generation from its parent user message.
The new response streams over WebSocket. Returns the user message details and deleted message ID.

message_id.description: UUID of the assistant message to regenerate

400.description: Message not found, not an assistant message, or no parent user message

get.description:
Returns a sanitized read-only view of a publicly shared conversation session.
Does not require authentication. Rate-limited.
Sensitive fields (IDs, user data, tool calls) are excluded.

Returns a sanitized view of a single shared message pair (user question + assistant answer).
Does not require authentication. Rate-limited.

post.description:
Creates or updates (upserts) a thumbs-up/thumbs-down feedback on an assistant message.
Only assistant messages can receive feedback.

example.feedback_message: Very helpful breakdown of the keyword opportunities

400.description: Message not found or not an assistant message

delete.description: Removes the user's feedback on a specific message.

get.description:
Returns a paginated list of artifacts produced across all sessions for the authenticated user.
Filter by session, activity type, or agent namespace.
Returns a single artifact and marks it as read.
Returns artifact counts grouped by agent namespace - used for the notification badge counts.
Returns all available activity type values for use in the filter UI.
Returns paginated cloud stack content records for the authenticated account.

parameters.name: otto_project
parameters.description: Filter by OTTO project ID or hostname

parameters.name: gbp_local_project
parameters.description: Filter by GBP Local Project ID

parameters.name: status__in
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of statuses to filter by

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Search by target URL or keyword

get.description: Returns a single cloud stack content record by ID.

patch.description: Partially updates a cloud stack record. Cannot change `otto_project` after initial assignment.

delete.description: Soft-deletes a cloud stack record. Cannot be undone.

post.description: Triggers async AI content generation for the cloud stack. Consumes Hyperdrive credits on first build. Returns task IDs.

202.description: Build task queued; returns array of task IDs

400.description: Cloud stack is missing required Knowledge Graph fields

post.description: Publishes the generated cloud stack content to the specified cloud providers. Cloud stack must be in Generated, Unpublished, or Published status.

400.description: Cloud stack is not in an allowed status for deployment

post.description: Refreshes deployment status from cloud providers for the specified cloud stacks within an OTTO project.

get.description: Returns all active cloud providers available for deploying cloud stack content.
Returns available HTML templates for cloud stack content rendering, ordered by sort_order.

parameters.name: lang
parameters.description: Language code to render preview URLs in the user's app language

get.description: Returns a CSV export of deployed cloud provider stack content records. Pass filter params in the path.

parameters.name: params
parameters.description: URL-encoded query string with filter parameters (e.g. `otto_project=42&status=PUBLISHED`)

get.description: Returns paginated press release records for the authenticated account. Only parent records are returned (not variations).

parameters.name: otto_project
parameters.description: Filter by OTTO project ID or hostname

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Search by title, target URL, or keywords

post.description: Creates a new press release draft. Requires a Knowledge Graph with all 11 required business fields populated.

400.description: Validation error - missing Knowledge Graph fields or invalid target URL

get.description: Returns a single press release by UUID.

patch.description: Partially updates a press release. `knowledge_graph` and `otto_project` cannot be changed after deployment.

delete.description: Soft-deletes a press release. Returns 403 if the associated OTTO project is frozen.

403.description: Cannot delete - associated project is frozen

get.description: Returns the full press release record for preview. Works for both AI-generated and manually written content.

post.description: Triggers async AI content generation. Only valid for AI generation mode - returns 400 for manual mode.

202.description: Build task queued; returns array of task IDs

400.description: Invalid mode, missing required AI fields, or quota exceeded

get.summary: Get channels for a press release
get.description: Returns the distribution channels (with publication URLs and status) associated with a press release.

200.description: Paginated list of press release channels

get.description: Returns all available distribution channels with tier, credit cost, and publishing time information.
Returns available press release content types organized into Core Trophy and Secondary Trophy categories, with icons and descriptions.

post.description: Triggers an async export of publication links for the given press releases. Returns a task ID to poll for results.

400.description: Validation error or press release not found for this account

post.description: Submits the press release to Signal Genesys for distribution across selected channels. Consumes distribution credits.

get.description: Returns the list of content categories from the Signal Genesys network. Response is cached for 2 hours.
Returns all active backlink comparison projects for the authenticated user's account.

post.description:
Creates a new backlink comparison project with a primary website and optional competitor websites.
Triggers asynchronous backlink data retrieval for all websites.
Returns an error if a project with the same primary website already exists for this account.

400.description: Project with same primary website already exists, or invalid hostnames

get.description: Returns the primary website and competitor websites with their backlink metrics.

get.summary: List referring domains for a project
get.description:
Returns paginated referring domains pointing to the project's primary website.
Supports search, filtering by field ranges, and ordering.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Search phrase to filter by source_url or domain

parameters.name: ordering
parameters.description: Field to order by. Prefix with `-` for descending. Example: `-citation_flow`

parameters.name: domain_rating
parameters.description: Filter by domain rating range. Format: `min_to_max`. Example: `3to10`

get.summary: List referring domains for a competitor
get.description: Returns referring domains for a specific competitor website within the project.

parameters.name: competitor_id
parameters.description: Competitor website ID within the project

200.description: Paginated referring domains for the competitor

post.description:
Check if the user has enough refdomains quota to process the given URLs.
Returns per-URL refdomain counts and whether quota is sufficient.

urls.description: List of URLs/domains to check quota for

has_enough_quota.description: Whether the user has enough quota for all new URLs

customer_has_processed.description: Whether this domain was already processed for this account

get.description: Returns all backlink research entries for the authenticated user, ordered by most recent.

post.description:
Initiates backlink research for a URL. Analyzes backlinks, referring domains,
anchor text distribution, and top pages. Results are processed asynchronously.

200.description: Research created or existing entry returned

get.description:
Returns detailed backlink research data including domain rating, URL metrics,
top anchor text, top linking domains, top linking pages, and top pages.
Triggers a fresh backlink data pull for an existing research entry. Consumes quota.

schema.description: Returns 1 on success to confirm the recrawl was queued.

get.summary: Get detailed backlink data by context
get.description:
Returns detailed backlink data for a specific context type (anchor text,
linking domains, linking pages, top pages) with pagination and date filtering.
Returns the count of external pages linking to this research target's root domain.

get.summary: Get linking pages for a specific domain or target page
get.description:
Returns linking pages data for a specific linking domain or target page
within a backlink research entry. Used for drawer/detail views.

count.description: Total number of linking pages for this domain/page/anchor.

get.description: Returns all backlink profile analyses for the authenticated user.

post.description:
Compares backlink profiles of a primary website against competitor websites.
Each website can be analyzed at `root_domain`, `subdomain`, or `page` scope.

get.description: Returns the full backlink profile comparison data for the given analysis.

competitor_scope.description: Scope used for this competitor (root_domain, subdomain, page).

post.description:
Finds referring domains linking to competitors but not to your primary website.
Use `min_matching_targets` to filter by how many competitors a referring domain must link to.

get.description: Returns paginated link gap data showing domains linking to competitors but not to you.

values.description: Each item is an array of column values corresponding to the columns array.

get.description: Returns all outreach campaigns for the authenticated user with pagination and metrics.

post.description:
Creates a new link building outreach campaign with target keywords, email configuration,
and scheduling settings. Triggers async processing to find outreach opportunities.

get.description: Returns all email accounts linked to the customer account for use in campaigns.

post.summary: Update daily send limit for a linked email
post.description: Updates the daily email sending limit for a specific linked email account.

get.description: Returns all campaign project folders for the authenticated customer.

post.description: Creates a new project folder to organize outreach campaigns.

delete.description: Deletes a campaign project folder.

get.description: Returns the global domain/email blacklist - domains excluded from all campaigns for this customer.

put.description: Replaces the global domain/email blacklist for this customer account.

delete.description: Disconnects and removes a linked SMTP or OAuth email account from the customer's configuration.

parameters.name: linked_email_id
parameters.description: ID of the linked email to remove

get.description: Returns time-series performance data for a campaign (emails sent, opens, replies) for charting.

put.description: Updates campaign settings including name, keywords, and email configuration.

delete.description: Permanently deletes an outreach campaign and all associated opportunities, contacts, and scheduling data.

get.description:
Returns the sending schedule settings for a campaign including daily limits,
active days of the week, send time window, and counts of scheduled opportunities/contacts.

200.description: Campaign settings with scheduled opportunity and contact counts

get.description: Returns the domain/email blacklist specific to this campaign.

put.description: Replaces the domain/email blacklist for a specific campaign.

post.description:
Imports outreach opportunities into a campaign from a CSV file upload.
Each row should contain at minimum a domain/URL for the outreach target.

file.description: CSV file with domain/URL and optional contact columns

post.summary: Send bulk outreach emails for a campaign
post.description:
Sends outreach emails to multiple scheduled opportunities in a campaign simultaneously.
Requires a linked email, subject, and body template. Optional context variables
are available for personalization (e.g., `{first_name}`, `{domain}`).

example.subject: Link collaboration opportunity - {domain}
example.body:
Hi {first_name},

I came across your site and thought we might collaborate...

post.description:
Marks a set of opportunities as scheduled, adding them to the campaign's
automated sending queue to be sent according to the campaign's schedule settings.

put.description:
Updates the automated sending schedule for a campaign including daily limit,
send time window (send_from / send_to hours), and active days of the week.

get.description: Returns all email templates available for the authenticated customer's campaigns.

post.description:
Creates a new reusable email template. Templates support variable substitution
using `{variable_name}` syntax (e.g., `{first_name}`, `{domain}`, `{keyword}`).

example.name: Guest Post Pitch
example.subject: Guest post opportunity for {domain}
example.body:
Hi {first_name},

I'd love to contribute a guest post to your site...

put.description: Updates an existing email template's name, subject, or body.

delete.description: Permanently removes an email template from the customer's template library.

get.description:
Returns outreach opportunities (discovered websites to contact) for a campaign.
Each opportunity has contact data, domain metrics, and scheduling status.

parameters.name: campaign_id
parameters.description: Campaign ID to list opportunities for

post.summary: Send outreach email to a specific opportunity
post.description:
Sends an outreach email to all contacts associated with a specific opportunity.
Requires a linked email account, subject, and body. Supports variable substitution.

example.subject: Collaboration opportunity
example.body: Hi {first_name}, I wanted to reach out about a link exchange...

delete.description: Removes an outreach opportunity from a campaign. Any sent emails are preserved in the inbox.

post.summary: Create a contact for an opportunity
post.description:
Creates a new contact associated with an outreach opportunity. Contacts are the
individual people at a website who will receive outreach emails.

delete.description: Removes a contact from an opportunity.

post.description: Deletes multiple contacts in a single request.

Updates the relationship milestone for an outreach conversation.
Milestones track the progress of a link building negotiation.

get.description:
Returns a paginated list of articles/pages for the authenticated user's account.
Supports filtering by status, project, brand vault, and ordering.

parameters.name: ordering
parameters.description: Field to sort by. Prefix with `-` for descending. E.g. `-created_at`

post.description:
Creates a new article. Optionally crawls a target URL for content, accepts
a keywords list and location for SEO scoring, and can trigger AI outline
generation immediately.

get.description: Returns aggregate counts of articles grouped by status for the authenticated account.

patch.description:
Update shared fields (due_date, status, assigned_to_users, project_name, brand_vault_uuid)
across multiple pages at once.

delete.description: Soft-deletes multiple pages by UUID list.

get.description: Returns full page data including editor state, cleaned HTML, keyword data, and WP fields.

put.description: Full update of a page. Primarily used to update the associated hostname.

hostname.description: Domain hostname to associate with this page

patch.description:
Update one or more page fields: title, editor_state, cleaned_html, status,
meta_title, meta_desc, hero_image, hero_image_alt_text, language, version, etc.

delete.description: Soft-deletes the page. The page is no longer returned in list results but data is preserved for recovery.

patch.description: Set or clear the hero image and its alt text for a page.

get.summary: Get compact keywords and focus terms data
get.description:
Returns a lightweight snapshot of the page's SEO score, focus terms,
clustered focus terms, and questions. Used to initialize the editor sidebar.

Returns the full keyword scoring data: score, focus terms, clustered terms,
questions, competitors, SERP schema, and suggested word-count range.

post.description:
Add a new target keyword to the page, or replace an existing one
(`edited_id`). Provide either `country_code` or `location` + `location_id`.

delete.description: Remove a target keyword from the page.

get.description: Returns a list of keyword suggestions based on the page title and content.
Enhanced keyword suggestions with additional scoring signals.
Returns on-page SEO analysis, technical issues, and content recommendations.

post.summary: Analyze a specific URL for a page
post.description: Triggers analysis of the page against a specific live URL.

get.description: Triggers a fresh crawl of the page's associated URL to update its HTML content. Returns 400 if no html_analysis record exists for the page yet.

schema.description: Empty object on success

400.description: Page has no associated URL to recrawl

post.summary: Set article status via action endpoint
post.description: Update article status using action-style endpoints (e.g. `draft`, `published`).

get.description: Returns internal link opportunities for the page based on content analysis.
Enhanced internal link suggestions with additional context signals. Returns 503 if the external link-suggestion service is unavailable.

patch.description: Marks an internal link suggestion as dismissed so it no longer appears in the page's suggestion list. Both the target URL and the anchor keywords are stored to prevent the suggestion from re-appearing.

url.description: URL of the suggested link target to dismiss

keywords.description: Anchor keyword(s) associated with this suggestion

patch.description: Saves an internal link suggestion to the page's bookmarked list so the user can action it later without it being dismissed.

url.description: URL of the suggested link target to bookmark

get.description: Creates a new Google Doc with the article's content and returns the doc URL.

get.summary: Export content brief to Google Doc
get.description: Exports the page's content brief (headings, notes) as a Google Doc.
Returns the article's cleaned HTML content as a downloadable file (text/html). The response filename is derived from the page title.

schema.description: Full cleaned HTML of the article

post.description: Generates and returns a CSV export for the specified page UUIDs.

post.summary: Import content from a live URL
post.description: Crawls the given URL and imports its HTML content into the page editor.

post.summary: Parse spreadsheet for bulk article creation
post.description:
Upload a CSV/XLSX file or provide a Google Sheets URL to extract article titles
and keywords for bulk creation. Supports Brand Vault association.

gsheets_url.description: Google Sheets public URL (alternative to file upload)

post.description:
Publishes the article to the connected WordPress website. Supports post types,
categories, author, permalink, and scheduled publishing.
Sync multiple articles to their associated WordPress websites.

get.description: Returns all WordPress websites connected to the account with heartbeat status.
Returns current sharing/access settings for the page.

post.description: Update who can access the page and at what permission level.

get.summary: Get active viewers for a page
get.description: Returns a list of users currently viewing or recently active on this page.

post.summary: Query focus terms for a keyword
post.description:
Returns a set of NLP-derived focus terms, questions, and competitor data
for the given query keyword, country, and language.

get.description: Returns the user's saved focus terms history.

post.summary: Exclude a focus term from a page
post.description: Marks a single focus term as excluded so it no longer counts against the page score.

post.summary: Bulk exclude focus terms from a page
post.description: Marks multiple focus terms as excluded at once.

post.summary: Add custom focus terms to a page
post.description: Adds one or more custom focus terms to track for this page.
Returns suggested sentences where the given focus terms can be naturally inserted.
Returns suggested anchor positions in the article for the given link targets.

get.description: Returns all content audit tasks for the authenticated account.

post.description:
Initiates a content audit for the given URL and up to 3 target keywords.
Crawls the page and computes content score, technical score, focus terms, and SERP analysis.

400.description: Invalid URL or keyword validation failed

post.description: Creates multiple content audit tasks from a URL list, Google Sheets URL, or file upload.

get.description: Returns the full audit result including technicals, content analysis, focus terms, and internal link suggestions.

delete.description: Permanently deletes the content audit record and all associated analysis data.

get.description: Triggers a fresh crawl and re-analysis of the audit's URL. Returns the updated audit record after initiating reprocessing.

patch.description: Mark audit tasks or recommendations as complete/incomplete.

patch.summary: Dismiss an outlink suggestion from audit
patch.description: Marks an internal outlink suggestion as dismissed so it no longer appears in the audit's suggestion list.

url.description: URL of the outlink suggestion to dismiss

patch.summary: Dismiss an inlink suggestion from audit
patch.description: Marks an internal inlink (backlink) suggestion as dismissed so it no longer appears in the audit's suggestion list.

url.description: URL of the inlink suggestion to dismiss

get.summary: Export audit report to Google Doc
get.description: Creates a Google Doc with the full content audit report.
Returns the user's saved target keyword research history.

post.description:
Initiates SERP research for a given keyword. Returns data asynchronously -
poll `GET /api/target-keywords/{id}/` for results.

get.description: Returns full SERP data, competitor metrics, and content recommendations for the keyword.

post.summary: Save a target keyword to the list
post.description: Persists this target keyword to the user's saved research list.

post.summary: Remove a target keyword from the list

get.summary: Create a new page from a target keyword
get.description: Creates a blank page, attaches the target keyword to it, and returns the new page object. Consumes 1 article quota unit.

200.description: New page created from the target keyword

get.description: Returns all article projects for the account. Optionally filter by those with topical maps.

parameters.name: has_topical_map
parameters.description: Only return projects that have a topical map

post.summary: Create or rename an article project
post.description:
Create a new project with the given name and domain. If a deleted project
with the same name exists it will be restored. Sending `id` + `name` renames the project.

patch.description: Update AI generation settings (language, tone, content structure) for all articles in the project.

delete.description: Soft-deletes the project. Articles in the project become uncategorized.

post.summary: Add a page to a project
Auto-populate project AI settings from domain
post.description: Analyzes the domain and auto-fills AI settings (niche, tone, language, etc.) for the project.

get.description:
Returns AI-generated heading suggestions and content outline for the page.
Pass `should_get_history=true` to retrieve previous outline generations.
Returns 406 if the page still has the default title and no `content_topic` is supplied.

406.description: Page title is still default - provide content_topic

get.summary: Get AI content outline (standalone, no page UUID)
get.description: Generates an AI content outline without requiring an existing page. Accepts the same query params as the page-linked variant.
Returns AI-generated H1/H2 heading suggestions for the page. Accepts `content_topic`, `number_of_headings` (default 6), and optional `uuid` override query params.

post.description:
Generates a short content snippet for a keyword. Use `type: rewrite_content`
to rewrite existing content.
Creates multiple articles from content planner data with AI-generated content.

Generates a structured multi-step AI content outline (First Draft Generator v2)
linked to an existing page. Pass `should_get_history: true` to retrieve history.
Generates a first-draft outline without requiring an existing page UUID.

get.description: Returns the list of available AI template types with their input field definitions.

post.summary: Generate content from an AI template
post.description:
Executes an AI template (e.g. blog intro, meta description, product description)
with the provided input fields.

get.description: Returns previous template generation results filtered by template type.

post.description:
Generates an AI image using the specified prompt, aspect ratio, and engine.
Used for article hero images and inline images.

example.prompt: A futuristic running shoe on a mountain trail

post.summary: Generate AI hero image for page
post.description: Generates and attaches an AI hero image to the page based on page title and keywords.
Regenerates an existing article image using AI.

get.description: Returns the user's default AI generation settings (language, tone, POV, content type).

put.description: Replaces the user's default AI generation settings.

get.description: Returns all bulk meta-tag generation batches for the account.

post.description:
Upload a CSV file with columns `Company Name`, `Keywords`, and `Title` or `Page URL`
to generate bulk AI meta titles and descriptions.

get.summary: Get bulk SEO metadata batch details
get.description: Returns the processing status and results of a metadata batch.

parameters.name: hash
parameters.description: Public share hash for anonymous access

post.description:
Generates AI-powered meta title and meta description suggestions for a
given page title, keywords, and optional company info.

get.description: Returns the current status and generated meta tags for an async meta-tag generation job.

post.summary: Upload an image to GCP storage
post.description:
Uploads an image file to GCP Cloud Storage and returns the public URL.
Supported formats: JPEG, PNG, WEBP, GIF.
Maximum file size: 5 MiB.
Images can be reformatted on upload (WEBP default) and optionally constrained to an
aspect ratio.

format.description: Output format for the stored image

mode.description:
PERSISTENT = stored in `StoredImage` model with GCS URL;
TEMPORARY = ephemeral GCP upload (no DB record)

validation.description: Apply extra validation rules (e.g. GBP min 256px dimensions)

url.description: Public GCP URL of the uploaded image

400.description: Invalid file, unsupported format, or file too large

get.description:
Returns all active (non-archived) Brand Vaults for the authenticated customer.
Optionally filter by hostname using the `hostname` query parameter to retrieve a
specific Brand Vault without knowing its UUID.

parameters.name: hostname
parameters.description: Filter by exact normalized hostname (e.g. `example.com`). Returns the matching Brand Vault if found.

parameters.name: ordering
parameters.description: Order by field. Prefix with `-` for descending. Options: `name`, `created_at`, `updated_at`

200.description: Paginated list of active Brand Vaults

post.description:
Creates a new Brand Vault for the authenticated customer. The hostname is
normalized automatically (www stripped, lowercased). Triggers asynchronous RAG
initialization and optional business info autofill on creation.

400.description: Hostname already exists or is invalid

get.description: Returns full Brand Vault object including business info, AI settings, status, and computed fields.

patch.description:
Partially updates a Brand Vault. Supports updating `name`, `hostname`,
and `otto_project_id`. WordPress integration fields are also accepted.

delete.description: Permanently deletes a Brand Vault and all associated data.

get.description:
Returns aggregated metrics for the Brand Vault dashboard: word counts, page counts,
image/video counts (breakdown by source), and source processing status counts.

get.summary: List all Brand Vault content sources
get.description:
Returns all RAG content sources associated with this Brand Vault - domain crawls,
uploaded files, and URL sources. Used to populate the Sources tab.
Returns detailed metadata for a single Brand Vault content source.

delete.description: Removes a content source from the Brand Vault and deletes its indexed data from the RAG store.

get.description: Returns the structured business information stored on this Brand Vault.

patch.description:
Partially updates the business information for the Brand Vault. Supports all
business info fields including address components, tax IDs, UVP, and brand identity.

post.description:
Triggers an asynchronous AI task that crawls the Brand Vault's domain and
extracts structured business information. Returns a `task_id` that can be polled
via `GET /api/core/v1/task-results/{taskId}` to get the result.
